svg.title: Autonomous Repository Template architecture
svg.desc: A human request goes through setup scripts that instantiate or adopt a product repository. In the default supervised profile, a plan records one human-approved milestone, a coding agent such as Claude Code, Codex, or Cursor implements it, the project's own checks run, and the work comes back as local commits and a handoff for human review. The opt-in lite and full profiles add a planning gate check, verification cycles, and tracked state under .ai.
